name: heic-convert-dev
description: DEV-ONLY tooling for vendoring + testing. The app itself is vanilla JS with no build step and no runtime dependencies — everything it needs is committed under vendor/ and js/. Nothing here is required to serve the site. Note: libheif-js and client-zip are sources to vendor FROM; jszip is not vendored at all — it is only a ZIP READER used by the tests to verify our output with a different library than wrote it.

scripts.test: node test/verify.mjs && node test/verify.encode.mjs && node test/verify.zip.mjs && node test/verify.pdf.mjs && node test/verify.thumbnails.mjs && node test/verify.pwa.mjs
scripts.vendor: npm run vendor:libheif && npm run vendor:client-zip && npm run vendor:pdf-lib
